description: This file is a PHP class defining a controller for managing SEO regex patterns within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles listing, creating, editing, deleting, and displaying SEO regex entries in the admin interface.

classes.name: SeoRegex
classes.description: Controller class for managing SEO regex patterns in the OpenCart admin panel. Extends the core Controller class to provide CRUD operations and interface rendering for SEO regex settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the SEO Regex management interface. Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, and renders the main view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to return the list of SEO regex entries.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches paginated SEO regex entries, constructs URLs and pagination, and renders the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a SEO regex entry, populating fields if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a SEO regex pattern. Checks permissions, validates data, and interacts with the model.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected SEO regex entries after permission check.
